hero.subtitle: Plug Spotify login into your app with one shared Code Exchange flow for web and mobile.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Spotify uses the standard OAuth2 Authorization Code flow. After consent, the API creates a short-lived single-use exchange code in Redis and then your client exchanges it for the same JWTs you get from password login.

console.title: Spotify Developer Console
console.description: Create a Spotify application and set the callback URL to this API, then list the allowed post-login redirect URLs in your app.

api.title: API contract
api.description: The API exposes a start URL and a callback that issues the exchange code.

codeHeader.label: Start
codeHeader.context: Redirect the user to Spotify consent

codeHeader.label: Callback
codeHeader.context: Spotify redirects back to the API

userModel.title: User model
userModel.description: Spotify's unique user identifier is stored as `spotifyId` on the user record. Email comes from Spotify (scope `user-read-email`).
